tree.heading: Organ
tree.text: The term “organ” has the meaning given such term in section 121.2 of title 42, Code of Federal Regulations.

tree.heading: Organ procurement organization
tree.text: The term “organ procurement organization” means a qualified organ procurement organization described in section 273(b)(1) of this title.

tree.heading: Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network
tree.text: The term “Organ Procurementand 1 Transplantation Network” means the Organ Procurement and Transplantation Network established under section 274 of this title.
